title: Wave Plus Layer Influence Visualization
full_prompt:
Write a complete ManimGL script that visualizes an electromagnetic wave passing through a medium layer (like glass) and the resulting secondary wave generated by the layer's dipoles, demonstrating wave superposition. 

Your code must implement:
1. A custom `GraphAsVectorField` class inheriting from `VectorField` that samples points along a 3D axis and maps them to vectors representing wave displacement.
2. An `OscillatingWave` class (subclassing `VMobject`) that dynamically updates its points using an updater to simulate a propagating wave with configurable amplitude, phase, wavelength, and twist rate (polarization rotation).
3. An `OscillatingFieldWave` class that links the vector field to the oscillating wave so that the vectors dynamically track the wave's displacement.
4. A 3D scene (`WavePlusLayerInfluence`) containing a 3D coordinate system, an incoming primary wave, a slab representing the medium layer, a secondary phase-shifted wave generated within/by the layer, and the combined resultant wave showing the phase shift caused by the medium.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Incorrect 3D coordinate mapping using c2p with 3 coordinates on 2D axes
common_failure_modes.note: Ensure axes are explicitly ThreeDAxes when passing 3D coordinates to c2p.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Updater lag or accumulation of time causing wave phase drift
common_failure_modes.note: Use dt-based increments carefully or bind wave phase directly to scene time.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Vector field density too high causing performance degradation in 3D
common_failure_modes.note: Keep sample_resolution and x_density at reasonable limits to avoid rendering bottlenecks.
